accepted_domain_recovery: Recover fixed-plan, ordinary-role, generalist-team, and standard multi-objective governance baselines before adding the placement.
held_out_incremental_prediction: Compare held-out delivery, correction, delayed harm, lock-in, and real exit against the strongest ordinary-governance rival.
independent_replication: An external team repeats the preregistered comparison with bearer costs and nulls visible.
kill_criterion: No out-of-sample gain, proxy harm or lock-in appears, or an ordinary-governance rival performs as well.
native_equations: Standard multi-objective and receding-horizon governance comparators; Rosetta labels are never measurements.
native_objects: Long and short horizons T_L and T_S, bearer vector, voluntary role assignments, tie-breakers, exit costs, tragic residue, and delivery and harm outcomes.
no_placement_rival: Transparent ordinary governance with explicit horizons, responsibilities, appeals, and exit but no Emergentist or Rosetta placement.
permutation_challenge: Swap horizons and role assignments while holding tasks, bearers, authority, and resources fixed.
question: Do nested learning and responsibility horizons with explicit bearers, tie-breakers, and exit outperform ordinary governance rivals without proxy harm or lock-in?
survivor: An explicit horizon, bearer, tie-breaker, tragic-residue, and exit record.
title: Nested-horizon coordination
